title: Caprese: Change Impact Recommendation Using History and Runtime Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.14937v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Change impact recommendation identifies program entities potentially affected by source code changes. Historical co-changes and runtime dependencies provide complementary evidence, particularly in JavaScript, where dynamic and asynchronous behaviour complicates dependency analysis. We present Caprese, an open-source framework for function-level change impact recommendation in Node.js. Given a change set, it produces a ranked impact set of potentially affected functions. It supports repository-based recommendation through confidence-guided mining of recurring, change-set-relevant co-change patterns of varying lengths; dynamic recommendation through execution-derived dependencies involving calls, callbacks, events, timers, and shared state; and hybrid recommendation integrating both analyses. translated_title: Caprese：基于历史与运行时分析的变更影响推荐
translated_abstract: 变更影响推荐用于识别可能受源代码变更影响的程序实体。历史共变更和运行时依赖提供了互补的证据，尤其是在JavaScript中，动态和异步行为使依赖分析变得复杂。我们提出了Caprese，一个用于Node.js函数级变更影响推荐的开源框架。给定一个变更集，它会生成一个按优先级排序的、包含可能受影响函数的影响集。它支持三种推荐方式：通过置信度引导地挖掘反复出现的、与变更集相关的不同长度的共变更模式，实现基于仓库的推荐；通过执行时衍生的依赖关系（涉及调用、回调、事件、定时器和共享状态），实现动态推荐；以及整合两种分析的混合推荐。其模块化实现支持可复用的分析。在十个开源应用和100个选定变更集上的评估表明，平均而言……
tldr: Caprese是一个面向Node.js的开源函数级变更影响推荐框架，它结合历史共变更挖掘与运行时依赖分析，生成可能受代码变更影响的函数排序列表。
en_tdlr: Caprese is an open-source framework for function-level change impact recommendation in Node.js that combines historical co-change mining with runtime dependency analysis to produce ranked impact sets of potentially affected functions.
